note: A single pull-through grass site in full sun for up to ten people on Jews Run Road, at its junction with an unnamed forest road that Google Maps calls Fish Dam Road. The agency's route from Renovo follows PA 144 south 13.4 miles, turns sharp right onto Jews Run Road and reaches the site on the left in about two miles. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. No table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: SS021 still listed, Drive-In, Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 30 ft, pull-through grass driveway 60 ft; count 1, 30 ft and pull_through confirmed. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows (Reserved 2026-11-20 to 11-22). Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri and PASDA): an open pull-through loop about 30 m across around a small tree island at a road junction, pin on the island; pin on site. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' No grade lines, no Severe grade, no 4WD, wet-weather or low-clearance statement (clearance 50 ft). Kept. Boilerplate on every page of the district, not site-specific: 'State forest roads are not maintained in the winter and often become snow covered, icy and potentially impassable' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
ATV check (ruling 1): nothing on the site page, GIS record or district map places this site in an ATV parking lot. Kept.

Sproul advisories page (read 2026-11-10): nothing on this site's road. It carries a Bloody Skillet ATV section closure (April 20, 2026), the indefinite Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road closure, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' and a dust advisory.

NAME: the '(Snow Shoe)' in the stored name is only the booking system's loop label. The site is on Jews Run Road, about two miles off PA 144, 13.4 miles south of Renovo. Suggest a name that says where it is; apply.py does not write names.

Agency pages disagree on the district's own inventory: the Sproul camping page says 'Sproul State Forest offers nine roadside campsites for overnight camping in RVs. No tent camping permitted. Self-contained toilets are required.' while the booking system sells many more Sproul sites than nine. Nothing here depends on it.
